_comment: Standalone sections: generated like /blog/, not in the nav, never linked from main-site pages. Found through sitemap.xml, llms.txt, llms-full.txt and IndexNow. scripts/build-standalone.mjs renders them; scripts/standalone/check-isolation.mjs fails if a main-site page links in. To add a section, add an entry here and a renderer for its kind in build-standalone.mjs.
